newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, CPO higher.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, CPO higher.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Wednesday, while crude palm oil was higher, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,445 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,279 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, compared with the previous tender price of 1,252 rupiah.
"The market was quiet, with the general election on the minds of many players," one trader said. "They are trying to keep stocks low in case of any problems."
"Increases in the Malaysia market just passed us by," one trader said, adding that technical buying pushed up values in the neighbouring country.
Campaigning in the five-yearly general election entered its fourth day on Wednesday, but political leaders took time off to attend the wedding of President Suharto's youngest son.
The traders said players were expected to stay cautious until after polling day on May 29.
Data from Belawan Port in North Sumatra showed that the MT Super Ace will leave on Wednesday for Surabaya in East Java with 1,250 tonnes of palm olein.
